name: Rizz the Wolf
source:
It's Valentine's day and you're about to confess your love to the most popular Lone Wolf in your school. The only question is if he'll be willing to accept you as his?

AN APRIL FOOL'S PARODY OF "The Kid at the Back"

[From [url=https://fantasia-kittcat.itch.io/rizz-the-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是情人节，你即将向学校里最受欢迎的独狼表白你的爱。唯一的问题是他是否愿意接受你为他的人？

愚人节对“后面的孩子”的模仿

[来自[url=https://fantasia-kittcat.itch.io/rizz-the-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
